{C:8190B701}{C:81958296962600000000}Heeey, Japanese!

{C:8190B501}{C:81958296972600000000}{C:819782830400}Chibodee Crocket{C:819782830000}?!
What are you doing here?

{C:8190B701}{C:81958296982600000000}Tsk, tsk, tsk.
Let's not ask each other that.
We're in the same boat, aren't we?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296992600000000}Who is he?

{C:8190B501}{C:819582969A2600000000}He's a Gundam Fighter like me.
I hate to admit it,
but he's a skilled fighter.

{C:8190B701}{C:819582969B2600000000}Why, whyyy?
What's gotten into you, Japanese?!
You're actually praising someone!

{C:8190B501}{C:819582969C2600000000}Facts are facts.
Besides, given the situation,
I want skilled people on our side.

{C:8190B701}{C:819582969D2600000000}I've heard what's going on.
All right.
I'll join you too.


{x00}

{C:81900400}{C:819582969F2600000000}Look, look! There's someone over there.
What's he doing?

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296A02600000000}{C:819782830400}Wufeiii{C:819782830000}?
Where the hell have you been all this time?!

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296A12600000000}I've been watching this battle,
considering which side is right...

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A22600000000}And have you reached a conclusion?

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296A32600000000}Yes...
I'll side with you.



{x00}

{C:81930100}{C:81958296A42600000000}Thank you, Wufei!

{C:8190D201}{C:81958296A62600000000}But don't forget.
If your cause isn't just,
I'll leave at any time.

{C:8190CF01}{C:81958296A72600000000}Tch! What a show-off!

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF2600000000}This place is really devastated.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296E02600000000}Yeah, it's almost frightening.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296E12600000000}Posaydal wiped out a clan called the
{C:819782830400}Yaman{C:819782830000}, and this was their land.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296E22600000000}Wiped out...
Then the other continents
were still lucky.

{C:81905300}{C:81958296E32600000000}That's exactly why we have to
crush Posaydal's ambitions.




{x00}

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296E42600000000}Heeey.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E52600000000}Oh, it's you, Chum.
Is Sho with you too?

{C:81901A00}{C:81958296890000000000}Of course. We were just saying
that this continent
reminds us of Byston Well.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E62600000000}Byston Well?

{C:81901A00}{C:819582968A0000000000}I couldn't really say
what exactly reminds me of it, though.


{C:81905500}{C:81958296E72600000000}Oh, everyone's here.
...Huh?
Lilis, what are you doing?

{C:81901B00}{C:81958296E82600000000}I'm not Lilis, you know.
I'm Chum Huau.


{C:81905400}{C:81958296E92600000000}Kyaooo.
Have you seen Daba?
Huh?


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81935500}{C:81958296EA2600000000}Heh heh, hehehehehe.

{C:81935400}{C:81958296EB2600000000}What is it, Kyao?
That's a strange laugh.

{C:81935500}{C:81958296EC2600000000}Um, Chum, was it?
Could you smile for me a little?

{C:81931B00}{C:81958296ED2600000000}Is this all right?
(Smiles)

{C:81935500}{C:81958296EE2600000000}All right! We've practically won already!


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81901A00}{C:819582968B0000000000}Kyao, was it?
Could you explain
what you meant just now?

{C:81905500}{C:81958296EF2600000000}"If you want to rule the world, smile with a fairy."
That's a proverb
where I come from.

{C:81958296F02600000000}We've got two fairies smiling for us!
If we can rule the world, there's no reason
we should lose to Posaydal.

{C:81901A00}{C:819582968C0000000000}I see.
Then our victory's assured.
Right?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296F12600000000}Smile with a fairy... I like that.
It's reassuring to have even a proverb on our side.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296F22600000000}Men can be so cute.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296F32600000000}Hehehe, they really can.



{x00}
